name: Court Collector : Idle Clicker
description: Build your tennis legacy from the baseline to the grand slam. Tap to earn points, unlock upgrades, expand your racket empire, and dominate the courts in this exciting idle clicker adventure.

name: Huemino
description:
Looking for a relaxing yet challenging brain teaser? Welcome to Huemino!

The rule is simple: Connect the colored blocks based on the numbers provided. The number on each clue indicates how many adjacent blocks need to be filled.
